scope: Public-photo development fixtures, not an unseen physical warehouse benchmark. Truth was visually annotated before model evaluation. Only normalized image bytes reach the model.

cases.title: Four separated battery pieces
cases.attribution: AA batteries — Dmitry G; original bytes, no local edits.
cases.annotation: Four complete separated batteries of different brands. Model/type/voltage text is not an ERP SKU. No PO identity or stock arrival is established.

cases.title: One complete bearing assembly
cases.attribution: Ball bearing — Solaris2006; CC BY-SA license migration option; original bytes, no local edits.
cases.annotation: One complete bearing, not a shipment of its internal steel balls. No legible SKU or lot. Surface appearance cannot establish functional quality.

cases.title: Overlapping batteries require a retake
cases.attribution: Four AA batteries — Metalphoenix; Commons crop/gamma correction by Wdwd; no further local edits.
cases.annotation: Four apparent batteries, but the rear diagonal one is obscured. Strict pilot requires separated complete objects; no accepted count should be emitted.

cases.title: Cropped batteries require a wider view
cases.attribution: Duracell AA batteries — Mygoodsweaties; worldwide public-domain release on Commons source page; original bytes.
cases.annotation: Top and bottom batteries cross the image boundary; glare and blur. Neither brand nor best-before date is an ERP identity or supplier lot.

cases.title: Outer carton is not its contents
cases.attribution: Cardboard box — MrBeastRapper; original JPEG and EXIF orientation preserved in fixture, normalized only on intake.
cases.annotation: One open carton. Hidden contents unknown, not a sealed package. Do not infer part quantity from box flaps, printed form or the carton count. Condition review allowed.

cases.title: Outdoor scene is not receiving evidence
cases.attribution: Blue sky image — Renukarenu1861; original bytes, no local edits.
cases.annotation: Clouds, palm trees and distant aircraft are not receiving goods. No count or identity can be promoted to stock.
